title: Anima Map Manifest
description: Schema for an Anima-Engine map manifest (M0.5 / test S05). Binds a World Artifact (ANMW) to the shared coordinate system, the 22/11 biome taxonomy, and the canonical camera/view list consumed by the map-vision gate (WORLD_SIMULATION_PLAN.md §13). Missing any required field makes a manifest invalid.

worldArtifact.description: Reference to the shared World Artifact this map renders (see src-tauri/src/core/world_artifact.rs).

path.description: Repo-relative or absolute path to the .anmw artifact bytes.

magic.description: Artifact magic; must be the literal ANMW.

version.description: WORLD_ARTIFACT_VERSION the artifact was written with.

seaLevel.description: Normalized sea level [0,1] shared by frontend and backend.

checksum.description: Optional content checksum (e.g. sha256:...) of the artifact bytes.

coordinateSystem.description: World-space bounds shared by render, collision, navigation and simulation. Values are fixed by SIMULATION_RULES.md / resources.rs MapBounds::default.

worldMinXZ.description: Minimum world X and Z (a 200x200 world-unit square).

biomeTaxonomy.description: Biome taxonomy sizes: 22 canonical frontend biomes lifted from 11 legacy backend biomes.

views.description: Canonical camera views inspected by the map-vision gate. At least one required.

imagePath.description: Path the rendered image for this view WILL occupy. A path here is a destination, not a claim that a file exists — see `captured`.

captured.description: Whether `imagePath` has actually been rendered and written. False (or absent) means the camera block is a specification for a future capture. src/__tests__/mapManifestEvidence.test.ts enforces the implication: any view with captured=true must have the file on disk. This field exists because the manifest previously listed eight images that did not exist, and nothing failed.

target.description: Camera world-space look-at target [x, y, z].
